cases.sentence: Боже, услышь ___ мою, и от мольбы моей не таись.
cases.translation: God, hear my prayer, and do not hide from my supplication.
cases.explain: Молитву is the direct object of the verb 'услышь' (hear), taking the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Думы томят меня, я в смятении от голоса ___.
cases.translation: My thoughts trouble me and I am confused by the voice of the enemy.
cases.explain: The preposition 'от' (from) governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Они навели на меня беду и враждуют со мною, пылая ___.
cases.translation: They bring misfortune upon me and contend with me, burning with anger.
cases.explain: The instrumental case is used with the preposition 'с' (with) when describing the manner or quality of an action.

cases.sentence: Сердце мое томится, ужасы смерти напали на меня, я бежал бы от ___.
cases.translation: My heart is troubled, the horrors of death have overtaken me, I would flee from misfortune.
cases.explain: The noun after verbs of fleeing or escaping takes the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Кто дал бы мне крылья ___, я улетел бы и обрел покой.
cases.translation: If only I had the wings of a dove, I would fly away and find rest.
cases.explain: The construction 'крылья + genitive' (wings of a dove) uses the genitive to indicate possession or belonging.

cases.sentence: Вижу я в ___ насилие и раздор, день и ночь они обходят его по стенам.
cases.translation: I see violence and strife in the city; day and night they patrol its walls.
cases.explain: The preposition 'в' (in) with location governs the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Смути их, владыка, раздели их ___, так как вижу я насилие и раздор.
cases.translation: Confuse them, Lord, divide their languages, for I see violence and strife.
cases.explain: Языки is the direct object of the verb 'раздели' (divide), taking the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Возложи на Господа свою ___, и Он тебя подкрепит.
cases.translation: Cast your care upon the Lord, and He will sustain you.
cases.explain: Заботу is the direct object of the verb 'возложи' (cast), taking the accusative case.

reading.ru: Боже, услышь молитву мою, и от мольбы моей не таись, услышь меня и ответь мне.
reading.question: What does the psalmist ask God not to do?
options: Hide from his supplication and not answer him
reading.correct: Hide from his supplication and not answer him
reading.explain: Боже, услышь молитву мою, и от мольбы моей не таись, услышь меня и ответь мне — God, hear my prayer, do not hide from my supplication, hear me and answer me.

reading.ru: Думы томят меня, я в смятении от голоса врага, от притеснения нечестивого.
reading.question: What troubles the psalmist?
options: His thoughts trouble him and he is confused by the enemy's voice and the oppression of the wicked
reading.correct: His thoughts trouble him and he is confused by the enemy's voice and the oppression of the wicked
reading.explain: Думы томят меня, я в смятении от голоса врага — My thoughts trouble me; I am confused by the voice of the enemy.

reading.ru: Они навели на меня беду и враждуют со мною, пылая гневом.
reading.question: What do his enemies do to him?
options: They bring misfortune on him and contend with him, burning with anger
They give him gifts and show him kindness
reading.correct: They bring misfortune on him and contend with him, burning with anger
reading.explain: Они навели на меня беду и враждуют со мною, пылая гневом — They bring misfortune on me and contend with me, burning with anger.

reading.ru: Я сказал, кто дал бы мне крылья голубя, я улетел бы и обрел покой, далеко улетел бы и жил в пустыне.
reading.question: What does the psalmist wish for?
options: To have dove's wings so he could fly away and find rest in the wilderness
reading.correct: To have dove's wings so he could fly away and find rest in the wilderness
reading.explain: Я сказал, кто дал бы мне крылья голубя, я улетел бы и обрел покой — I said, 'If only I had dove's wings, I would fly away and find rest.'

reading.ru: Смути их, владыка, раздели их языки, так как вижу я в городе насилие и раздор.
reading.question: Why does the psalmist ask God to confuse the evildoers?
options: Because he sees violence and strife in the city
Because he is jealous of them
reading.correct: Because he sees violence and strife in the city
reading.explain: Смути их, владыка, раздели их языки, так как вижу я в городе насилие и раздор — Confuse them, Lord, for I see violence and strife in the city.

reading.ru: Возложи на Господа свою заботу, и Он тебя подкрепит, никогда Он не даст поколебаться праведнику.
reading.question: What promise does the psalmist make about God's care for the righteous?
options: Cast your cares on the Lord and He will sustain you; He will never let the righteous be shaken
The Lord will make you rich and powerful
The Lord will defeat all your enemies
The Lord will never let you suffer
reading.correct: Cast your cares on the Lord and He will sustain you; He will never let the righteous be shaken
reading.explain: Возложи на Господа свою заботу, и Он тебя подкрепит, никогда Он не даст поколебаться праведнику — Cast your care on the Lord and He will sustain you; He will never let the righteous be shaken.
